current.text: Mark Williams is out long term with a torn labrum, expected to miss 5 to 6 months. This opens the starting center spot in Phoenix.
The Suns starting center job is not officially settled. Oso Ighodaro is his competition for the starting spot and the minutes.
Experts expect Maluach to start over Ighodaro. He seems almost locked in as the starter, and Phoenix wants its top 10 pick in that spot.
He is projected for about 24 to 25 minutes per game.
He averaged 18 points, 13 rebounds, 2 blocks and 2 threes in summer league and was a top 10 fantasy player there.
Draft him as a flyer around round 10, not later. Do not take him inside the top 100. He has top 75 upside.

durable.text: He is a big man who adds rebounding, shot blocking and FG%, and he can shoot some threes. He should be an okay free throw shooter.
He is a strong rim protector. He turned 31.5% of his rim contests into blocks.
Blocks are his standout category, far above the player pool. Rebounds and FG% also help.
He gives almost nothing in steals and assists, even for a center.

note: Yahoo ranks him 118 with a 1.5 USD average cost, and ESPN ranks him 202 at 0 USD. That puts him close to our 144-player cutoff, so he should cost only 1 to 3 USD at the end of the auction. Experts say his ceiling is the top 75. His value comes from blocks, with help in rebounds and FG%. He fits punt AST and punt STL builds best. Early in the season, check that he starts over Oso Ighodaro and plays 24 or more minutes while Mark Williams is out.
